COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(C.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE,C.BUYER) AND TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = DECODE(C.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001',C.DELY_TO_LOCATION)))) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION -- 납품장소 8 , MAX(A.REMARK_INV) 컬럼 삽입 1 ~ 4 , MAX(P.QRY_STR1) AS QRY_STR1 , MAX(P.QRY_STR2) AS QRY_STR2 , MAX(P.QRY_STR3) AS QRY_STR3 , MAX(P.QRY_STR4) AS QRY_STR4 , MAX(P.DEFAULT_RPT_URL) AS DEFAULT_RPT_URL -------------------------------<-- 저장,삭제버튼 노출여부 컬럼 ------------------------------------------------ , CASE WHEN ( SUM(NVL(B.GR_QTY,0)) = 0 --(고객사)입고수량 AND SUM(NVL(B.WMS_GR_QTY,0)) = 0 --(WMS)입고수량 AND SUM(DECODE(B.HUB_FLAG, 'C', 1, 'G', 1, 0)) = 0 --(간선)입출고 ) THEN CASE WHEN MAX(A.BUYER) = 'KRKORE0212' AND MAX(DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',TO_DATE(D.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') - DECODE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'D'),3,1,2), TO_DATE( D.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'))) BETWEEN SYSDATE - 6 AND SYSDATE + 6 THEN '11' --저장,삭제버튼 노출 WHEN MAX(A.BUYER) != 'KRKORE0212' THEN '11' IMAGE_KEY_INV ,MAX(A.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN) AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN ,MAX(A.PARCEL_COM_CODE) AS PARCEL_COM_CODE ,MAX(A.PARCEL_INV_NO) AS PARCEL_INV_NO ,MAX(A.INV_NO) AS INV_NO ,MAX(A.BUYER) AS BUYER ,MAX(C.AGENT) /*selectMasterMpSoTranStatementDetailPopList*/ SELECT C.REF_PR_NO -- [00] 관리번호 , C.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- [01] 품목코드 , C.DESCRIPTION||DECODE(TRIM(C.MAKER_NAME),NULL,'',' / '||C.MAKER_NAME) AS DESCRIPTION -- [02] 품명 , C.SPECIFICATION -- [03] 규격 , C.ITEM_QTY -- [04] 발주수량 , C.UNIT_MEASURE -- [05] 단위 , A.INV_QTY -- [06] 납품수량 , A.UNIT_PRICE -- [07] 단가 , A.UNIT_PRICE*A.INV_QTY AS INV_UNIT_AMT -- [08] 공급가액 , A.DS_DATE -- [09] 납품예정일 -- , DECODE(C.PROCESS_TYPE, '0',C.RD_DATE, F_GET_DATE_TR(C.RD_DATE)) AS RD_DATE , C.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE , C.PO_NO -- [11] 발주번호 , C.PO_SEQ -- [12] 발주항번 , A.INV_QTY -- [13] 송장수량 , C.PROCESS_TYPE -- [14] 제품조달방법 , A.INV_SEQ -- [15] 송장항번 , C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- [16] , C.CONTRACT_NO -- [17] , C.CONTRACT_SEQ -- [18] , C.LEGACY_PO_NO -- [19] , C.REF_PR_NO -- [20] , DECODE(C.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',C.WAREHOUSE_CODE,C.BUYER) AS TR_BUYER -- [21] , B.ADD_USER_ID -- [22] , C.DELY_TO_LOCATION -- [23] , C.ACCOUNT_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE -- [24] , DECODE(C.ACCOUNT_TYPE,'X' ,SUBSTR(C.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) ,( SELECT STDCATLG_ID FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ)) AS STDCATLG_ID -- [25] , DECODE(C.ACCOUNT_TYPE,'X',( SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(C.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO -- [26] , C.AGENT_PRICE -- [27] 단가2 , C.AGENT_PRICE*A.INV_QTY AS INV_AGENT_AMT -- [28] 공급가액2 , A.INVOICE_DATE -- [29] , NVL(A.INV_QTY,0)-NVL(A.DELIVERY_QTY,0) AS REMAIN_QTY -- [30] , C.BUYER -- [31] ,F_GET_MSDS_INFO(C.BUYER, C.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,1) AS MSDS_NO , DECODE(C.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', NVL((SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'),0) , NVL(C.IV_QTY,0)) AS INV_COMP_QTY -- 기납품수량 FROM ICOMIVDT A, ICOMPOHD B, ICOMPODT C WHERE A.INV_NO = #{st_inv_no} AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D'
/*getW001Flag*/ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND TEXT4 = 'B' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 =#{st_buyer}
